leaves.name: mainTheoremCMPol
leaves.doc: mtcm-polar: the main theorem of complex multiplication for polarized CM abelian varieties of type (E, Phi; a, zeta) with a a fractional O_E-ideal, sign of the Artin map existential (t = N(s)^eps): for a CM field E with CM type Phi, its reflex field E* and reflex norm N (det_E on a model of C^Phi over E*), sigma in Aut(C) and an idele s of E* with sigma = [s, E*] on E*^ab, an abelian variety A/C uniformized by C^g/Phi(a) of type (E, Phi), a an O_E-ideal lattice, with a Riemann form Tr(zeta x ybar) (zeta-bar = -zeta, Im phi_i(zeta) > 0, integral on a): A^sigma is uniformized by C^g/Phi(t^-1 a) with theta(Phi(x))^sigma = theta'(Phi(y)) whenever t y - x lies in a-hat. With CMAbVarExists and the textbook leaves it gives qmrec-printed's MainTheoremCM for every lattice (mainTheoremCM_of_pol); implied by MainTheoremCM (mainTheoremCMPol_of_mainTheoremCM).
leaves.flag: reading risk: whether Shimura 1998 Thm 18.6 / 1971 Thm 5.15 is printed for an arbitrary (not necessarily primitive) CM type, used at the induced type of E = K(sqrt 2); believed general (UNVERIFIED)
leaves.source: Shimura, Introduction to the arithmetic theory of automorphic functions (1971) Thm 5.15 with section 5.5; Shimura, Abelian varieties with complex multiplication and modular functions (1998) section 18, Thm 18.6; Shimura-Taniyama (1961) sections 13-14 (locators UNVERIFIED)

leaves.name: cmAbVarExists
leaves.doc: mtcm-polar: for a CM field E with CM type Phi, a fractional O_E-ideal b and zeta with zeta-bar = -zeta, Im phi_i(zeta) > 0 and Tr(zeta b bbar) in Z, there is an abelian variety B/C of dimension g with an analytic uniformization C^g/Phi(b) = B(C) (existence of a polarized abelian variety of type (E, Phi; b, zeta); the polarization and the action are dropped).
leaves.source: Shimura, Abelian varieties with complex multiplication and modular functions (1998) section 6.2 Thm 4; Shimura-Taniyama (1961) section 6.2 Thm 4; Mumford, Abelian varieties, section 3 (Riemann's theorem) (locators UNVERIFIED)
